purpose: Tester-only admission and shared fail-closed caps before the separately authorized Phase 1 production smoke. Render Hobby lacks web-service inbound IP rules.

profile.FREE_SMOKE_RUN_ID: fresh UUID, never changed to retry a failed attempt
profile.FREE_SMOKE_EXPIRES_AT: future UTC ISO timestamp, at most one hour and within the current UTC day; operational observation window remains 30 minutes
profile.FREE_SMOKE_ADMISSION_SHA256: SHA-256 of fresh 256-bit private admission token; raw token never in environment, Git, PR, artifacts or logs
profile.FREE_SMOKE_DIAGNOSTIC_ID: exact claimed target ID, only in the protected isolated AI runner
profile.partialInvalidExpiredProfile: deny controlled starts, email generation and AI calls; never silently fall back to an unrestricted profile
profile.absence: all profile fields and target ID absent preserves normal behavior; gates must be OFF before profile removal

admission.proof: exact Origin, streamed body limit, constant-time token digest, Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie
admission.boundary: server-side new anonymous start and access-email actions, including alternate Render ingress; page obscurity is not the boundary
admission.accountAccess: does not replace Auth, personally supplied consent, OTP, ownership or RLS
admission.claim: existing passwordless confirmation remains usable in the owner browser without copying the admission cookie

budgets.store: existing service-role-only public.consume_rate_limit; no migration or privilege grant
budgets.failure: no reservation release after timeout, validation error, provider error or process restart; no automatic new run
budgets.email: one recipient-bound generateLink plus one Resend HTTP request; provider itself has no retry loop
budgets.ai: one exact diagnostic, gpt-5.6-sol, OpenAI SDK maxRetries=0, max_output_tokens=16000; no mock substitution
budgets.scopeLimit: caps apply to these controlled acquisition/Individual entry points. Suspend and drain the ordinary worker before the smoke; no competing general queue consumer or unrelated external action is permitted.

rollout: Review exact candidate source and green application/isolated-sql CI. Separately approve merge/deploy of this new source; original Phase 1 source was pinned to baseSHA.
Deploy only the approved canonical SHA with all gates and the profile OFF; no DB migrations or privileges.
Before activation, refresh private per-row HMAC/schema/ledger/Auth/legal/storage baseline, queues and leases; verify both origins and no drift.
Finish and prove the protected one-off worker manifest on fake HTTP before installing a smoke profile. No production credentials are exported to local files.
Record exact protected environment preimage and runtime proof. Install the fresh web profile and real email provider only under the explicit execution manifest.
Use the private admission URL; owner personally consents. Open only acquisition start gates. Close DB/web new-start immediately after the one session exists.
Owner personally opens the one passwordless email. Bind the claimed diagnostic to the isolated runner; perform target scoring and one AI call. Produce and accept one PDF.
Close acquisition gates before removing the web profile. Stop/terminalize target retries safely, verify queues/leases, restore ordinary worker and exact environment preimage.
Compare all pre-existing row HMACs, history/schema/ledger/storage, permitted new target rows and three reservation keys. Preserve smoke records.

containment.claim: keep foundation only while resolving the already authorized claim; then ACQUISITION_ENABLED=false
containment.worker: stop bounded runner; wait for HTTP/lease settlement; never resume a general worker while target retry could send a second request
containment.profile: do not remove/change its run ID while acquisition gates are open. Expiry fails closed. Denied attempts do not authorize a reset.
containment.sourceRollback: all gates OFF first, no unresolved external operations, then separately approved prior canonical source; no DB restore or history deletion

prohibitions: No production mutation by this preparation
No real email/AI in local or CI tests
No merge or deployment without separate exact-source approval
limitations: Local/fake-provider tests are not production acceptance
Protected one-off runner integration and private per-row HMAC baseline must be proved before activation
Existing Phase 1 owner authorization is retained: one email, one AI, one PDF. No attempt has been spent.
